FFT pitch-lookup OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP -- 128 bytes, u8.
Used by midi_to_spu_pitch_lookup (FUN_80017424) as
  octave_shift = 6 - OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP[(a0 & 0x7FFF) >> 8]
Indices 0..107 follow the linear pattern
  floor(idx / 12)  (so 0..8 cycle through 12 entries each)
Indices 117..119 = 0 (padding); 120..127 = 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7.
Mirrored in smd-player/scripts/pitch_table.gd::OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP;
any drift between this ROM data and that constant is caught by
research/effect_alignment/probes/probe_constants_invariant.lua.

FFT pitch-lookup SEMITONE_LOOKUP -- 128 bytes, u8.
Used by midi_to_spu_pitch_lookup (FUN_80017424) as
  table_idx = SEMITONE_LOOKUP[(a0 & 0x7FFF) >> 8] * 256 + (a0 & 0xFF)
Indices 0..107 follow `idx % 12` (the obvious linear pattern).
WARNING: the tail entries DO NOT continue linearly:
  [112..116] = 4,5,6,7,8         (5 normal entries)
  [117..120] = 0,0,0,0           (padding)
  [121,123,125,127] = 32         (** the surprise **)
  [122,124,126]     = 2,4,6       (alternating normal)
Mirrored in smd-player/scripts/pitch_table.gd::SEMITONE_LOOKUP. The
first 8 bytes of SEMITONE_LOOKUP physically alias the last 8 bytes
of OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP (both label 0x80029060..0x80029067). See
PITCH_TABLE_TRUNCATION.md for the 2026-05-16 transcription-bug fix
where Godot had 1,3,5,7 at the surprise indices instead of 32,32,32,32.

FFT pitch-lookup PITCH_LOOKUP_TABLE -- u16 entries, byte-addressed.
Used by midi_to_spu_pitch_lookup (FUN_80017424) as
  result = TABLE[(SEMITONE_LOOKUP[oct] * 256 + (a0 & 0xFF)) * 2]
  result is then shifted by (6 - OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP[oct]).
Logical layout: 256 u16 entries per semitone bin. The formula
reaches up to semitone=32 (SEMITONE_LOOKUP's max value), so the
logically-required size is 33 * 256 = 8448 u16 entries = 16896
bytes. The observable contiguous data in RAM extends out to at
least 12288 u16 entries (24576 bytes); Godot mirrors the full
12288 in smd-player/scripts/pitch_table.gd::TABLE so the byte-for-
byte invariant in probe_constants_invariant.lua matches.

SMD opcode 0xEC handler -- arms LFO sub-slot 2 (chan+0x120..0x13F)
with mode 2 (pan-LFO) and HARDCODED callback_idx=3
(pitch_accum_callback / triangle). 3 params (p0, p1, p2):
  - p0 = inner_reload (sub+0x12)
  - p1 = step base; step_source = pitch_lfo_step_calc(p1<<24, p0, 3)
  - p2 = outer-delay reload (sub+0x16)
Sets sub+0x1A = 0x100 (depth_reload, FIXED), sub+0x1C = 2 (mode),
sub+0x1D = 3 (callback_idx), sub+0x1E = 3 (active_dir bits 0x1+0x2).
Sibling: FUN_80016A14 (op_ed) does the same but with callback_idx
from (p2 & 0xF). Disarmed by 0xEF (op_ef_clear_subslot2, LAB_80016AF0).

SMD opcode 0xEF handler -- disarms LFO sub-slot 2 by clearing bit
0x1 of chan+0x13E (sub+0x1E active flag). 0 params.
  lhu  v0, 0x13e(a2)
  andi v0, v0, 0xfffe   ; clear bit 0x1
  sh   v0, 0x13e(a2)
Counterpart to op_ec / op_ed which set the same bit.

chan+0x92 env-multiplier seed writer. Stores `(0x6000 * instr_byte)
>> 7` where instr_byte is per-sound-id (from the engine table at
*DAT_80032A00 + halfword(s5+0xc) + sound_id). Fires once per
channel during FUN_80013B20's per-channel init loop.
Sound-id -> instr_byte -> chan_92 examples:
  cure_4 (sid 4): 0x60 -> (0x6000*0x60)>>7 = 0x4800 = 18432
  protect (sid 9): 0x80 -> (0x6000*0x80)>>7 = 0x6000 = 24576
Godot mirrors via channel_state.gd::chan_92_value, orchestrator
plumbs the per-effect value via render_effect_sound's --chan92=
flag (sourced from diag_chan_92_writers.jsonl::new_value).

s4 = 1 -- Note-with-KON_ARM gate. Reached only when:
  - a Note byte (< 0x80) is dispatched this tick, AND
  - chan_word_0 bit 0x400 (KON_ARM) was set BEFORE the per-tick
    clear (i.e. a Rest / duration-tick / effect-load handler
    armed the next KON in a prior tick).
s4 is checked at PC 0x80015718 to fire the LFO sub-slot
period_reset at LAB_800157AC (clears acc, resets countdown, clears
dir bits 0x4/0x8). Without this gate firing, mid-effect LFO swap-
path direction toggles drift (protect_no_music chan_8a sign-flip).
Godot mirrors the gate at dispatcher.gd::cadence_body line ~1099
(`note_dispatched and (s2_snapshot & CHAN0_KON_ARM) != 0`) and
fires _apply_lfo_period_reset(channel) at the same point.

LFO sub-slot period_reset loop body. Iterates 3 sub-slots
(chan+0xFE, chan+0x11E, chan+0x13E = sub-slot 0/1/2's active+dir
flags). Gate: `(flags & 0x1) && (flags & 0x2)` -- active AND
first-segment. When the gate passes, the reset:
  - sub+0x04 = 0           (accumulator clear)
  - sub+0x10 = 1           (countdown reset to 1)
  - sub+0x14 = sub+0x16    (delay_counter reload)
  - sub+0x18 = sub+0x1A    (depth reload)
  - chan_word_0 |= 0x100   (CHAN0_VOL_PRESTAGE)
  - sub+0x1E &= ~0xC       (clear dir bits 0x4 and 0x8)
Outer gate at PC 0x80015718 is `s4 != 0` -- set at PC 0x80015488.
Godot port: dispatcher.gd::_apply_lfo_period_reset.
See CHAN_8A_PAN_LFO_SIGN_FLIP_INVESTIGATION.md for the protect_
no_music bug this loop fixes on the FFT side.

midi_to_spu_pitch_lookup -- encodes a (signed s16) midi*256+fine
value into an SPU pitch-register value.
  v1 = a0 & 0x7FFF              (mask off sign + upper)
  octave_index = v1 >> 8        (logical shift)
  fine_byte = a0 & 0xFF
  semitone = SEMITONE_LOOKUP[octave_index]      (0x80029060)
  octave_shift_raw = OCTAVE_SHIFT_LOOKUP[octave_index]  (0x80028FE8)
  table_idx = semitone * 256 + fine_byte
  base = PITCH_LOOKUP_TABLE[table_idx]          (0x800290D8)
  shift = 6 - octave_shift_raw
  return (s32)((s16)base >> shift)              if shift >= 0
         (s32)((s16)base << (-shift))           if shift <  0
Caller (FUN_80017118 PC 0x80017340..0x80017368) feeds
  a0 = sign_extend_s16(chan+0x82 + chan+0x88 + slot+0xA2)
and stores the masked 14-bit result to chan+0x46 (pitch_staging).
Note: NEGATIVE inputs are NOT clamped; the `andi 0x7FFF` mask treats
them as positive 0..32767 for octave_index. Godot's pitch_table.gd
originally had a defensive `if adjusted < 0: adjusted = 0` clamp
that was removed in commit d890cc6c to match this semantic.

smd_op_d8_pitch_lfo_init (opcode 0xD8) -- pitch-LFO init.
MUSIC_ITER21 finding (smd-player/docs/MUSIC_ITER21_PITCH_LFO_D8_DIVIDE_FIX.md):
  a0 = rate * rate   (sign-preserving for negative rate)
  a0 <<= 14
  a0 = pitch_lfo_step_calc(a0, period, 3)   ; with a2=3 this DIVIDES by period
  sub+0x0C (step_source) = a0
Chan+0xFE = 3 (mode 1 / alternating-swap callback @ LAB_80017690).
Godot's earliest port omitted the division and seeded
  step_base = (rate^2 << 14) UNDIVIDED
on the mistaken justification of probe d9_lfo_001 -- but d9 takes
a2 = waveform_index (wf_idx<2 → no division), whereas D8 always
passes a2=3 (always-divide). Channels 10/11 step_source=589824
Godot vs 117964 PCSX (5x too large) until the divide was restored.

pitch_lfo_step_calc inner LAB_80016C40 -- conditional division.
For a2 >= 2 (the value smd_op_d8 always passes): div a0, period;
mflo a0. For a2 < 2 (some smd_op_d9 waveforms): early-out at PC
0x80016C18-1C with NO division. This conditional explains why
MUSIC_ITER21 had to be specific about which opcode's seed gets
divided -- D8 always, D9 conditionally on its waveform-index param.

chan_word_0 |= 0x8000 closing bit-set inside the instrument-data
loader (entry at 0x80016FB4). MUSIC_ITER46 finding
(smd-player/docs/MUSIC_ITER46_*): gated on `chan_word_0 & 0xC == 0`
at PC 0x80017064-68. The bit feeds smd_note_kon_check at
PC 0x80015494-0x800154BC: when set, the dispatcher consumes it
(clears to 0x7FFF) and ORs 0x300 into slot+0x0
(FLAG_PRIMARY_KON | FLAG_SECONDARY_KON). Without this bit,
the KON-staging branch never fires on a port that mirrors only
the field copies (adsr1, adsr2, fine_tune, sample_start_addr),
explaining downstream KON-timing and envelope_tail divergence.

End-of-note ADSR2-LOW release-rate force (CHAN0_LAST_NOTE_FLAG
path). MUSIC_ITER58 finding (MUSIC_ITER58_MUSIC_86_END_OF_NOTE_*):
when `note_duration` decrements to 1 AND the post-walker look-ahead
has bit 0x1000 (CHAN0_LAST_NOTE_FLAG) set, the per-channel-tick
handler at PC 0x800152A0..C0 overwrites `chan+0x6A` with the
constant 6. The next walker pass then commits `release_shift = 6`
(fast linear decay) via spu_write_voice_adsr2_low (FUN_8001BAB8).
This is the FIRST of three release-rate write points for any
voice; the others are KON/instrument-load (path 1) and the
force-release loop at 0x80014EA4 (path 3). Skipping path 2
leaves an instrument's slow release_shift (10..12) on the SPU,
decaying 16x-64x slower than FFT intends on Rest-heavy tracks.

Force-release loop (path 3 of end-of-note ADSR2-LOW write).
MUSIC_ITER58 finding: after the per-channel-tick pass, an outer
loop at PC 0x80014EA4..0x80014ED0 iterates voices 23..0 and, for
every voice flagged in the global mask
  DAT_80032A08 | DAT_80032A20
calls spu_write_voice_adsr2_low(voice, 0x6, 0x3) -- release_byte=6,
mode=3 (linear). The mask is populated by callees fired from
per-channel-tick (FUN_80012338 / FUN_80012380 / FUN_800123CC at
PC 0x80014D94 and PC 0x80014DC0). Together with the
CHAN0_LAST_NOTE_FLAG path at 0x800152A0, this guarantees all
ended notes converge to release_shift=6 within one IRQ.

spu_write_voice_adsr2_low -- ADSR2 low-bits walker writer.
MUSIC_ITER32 finding (ADSR2_LOW_RELEASE_BYTE_FIELD_SOURCE): the
release_byte input is sourced from a DEDICATED slot+0x6A field
(the raw 5-bit release rate, no mode bit), NOT from slot.adsr2
& 0x3F. Godot's earliest port used the mask -- which preserved
stale mode-bit residue across walker passes -- and that caused
systematic divergence at probe_adsr2_low_register. The mode bit
(0x20 / release_mode_exp) is composed INSIDE this helper from the
separate a2=mode_byte register (derived from slot+0x58 by the
caller). When auditing release timing, read both fields
separately; do not assume slot.adsr2 reflects the latest C5 write.

LFO sub-slot period_reset loop body. Iterates 3 sub-slots
(chan+0xFE, chan+0x11E, chan+0x13E = sub-slot 0/1/2's active+dir
flags). Gate: `(flags & 0x1) && (flags & 0x2)` -- active AND
first-segment. When the gate passes, the reset:
  - sub+0x04 = 0           (accumulator clear)
  - sub+0x10 = 1           (countdown reset to 1)
  - sub+0x14 = sub+0x16    (delay_counter reload)
  - sub+0x18 = sub+0x1A    (depth reload)
  - chan_word_0 |= 0x100   (CHAN0_VOL_PRESTAGE)
  - sub+0x1E &= ~0xC       (clear dir bits 0x4 and 0x8)
Outer gate at PC 0x80015718 is `s4 != 0` -- set at PC 0x80015488.
Godot port: dispatcher.gd::_apply_lfo_period_reset. MUSIC_ITER50:
Godot SPLITS FFT's combined chan+0xFE halfword across two fields
(lfo_sub_active[i] = bit 0; lfo_sub_dir_flags[i] = bits 1+), so
gate translation cannot be a single mask compare -- it must read
both split fields. MUSIC_ITER34: the per-tick period reset also
mutates chan+0xFE (cycles 0→3→15→7→15→7 per FFT toggle); a port
that only mutates lfo_mode_flags from opcode arms misses this
cycle and stays stuck at bits 0/1 (≈3K diverged paired rows on
MUSIC_25).
